transcriber_notes: 認可年月日 written era+year.month.day; addresses with Arabic numerals.
Row '東亞電報通信', day: compressed stack of 4-5 short strokes (23 or 3 or 13?) -> [?].
Row '商業通信': year and month each two equal horizontal strokes, readable either as a full-size 二 or as two compressed 一 (一一) (2 or 11) -> [?].
Row '[?]國通信': first character of the title smudged (resembles 圖) -> [?].
Row '同盟通信' (first): year two equal horizontal strokes, readable either as a full-size 二 or as two compressed 一 (一一) (2 or 11) -> [?].
Row '同盟通信' (second), 發行所: printed 京城府太平通町 / 一丁目三一ノ二, kept as printed.
Row '朝鮮經濟日報': month printed as a small 二, read 2. Faint print.
